# pi-glance 0.6.9

- Redesign `/glance` with three sections: **Appearance**, **Status line**, and **Working**. Edit settings in one list, with live preview.
- Add **Sweep speed**, adjustable from 10 to 120 columns per second. Both animation modes share the setting; the default stays at 47.
- Make controls consistent: arrow keys adjust values, Enter confirms an edit, Esc cancels it, and S saves from the settings list.
- Remember navigation positions and ask before resetting or discarding unsaved changes.

Existing settings are kept. Config files are updated only when you save.

Tested with Pi 0.84.4 and 0.85.1 on Node.js 22.19.0 and 24.
